record.title: Copy observer return values and repeat stock capability control
record.intent: Query unchanged stock model and bandwidth policy using the validated synthetic entitlement seed.
requirements: Preserve capability-stock-01 and its gated derived arm. Copy the Frida onLeave return value before retaining it, following the documented callback lifetime contract. Record the immutable observed offset and later selected-record check; do not change stock model behavior.

Commit and push tasking before implementation. Prepare an explicitly derived guest fixture from the validated positive run, copying only pinned libraries, ART inputs, synthetic Key.data, FlexA.lic, crypto witness and canonical private stream.

Preserve the stock APK and native source bytes. Freeze seed hashes and require the complete option catalog to match the validated positive state. Do not install or regenerate any token or format private storage.

Use real ART/JNI/factory and original model/serial setters plus the existing declared synthetic DNA response. Record the selected model-table record and actual public GetModel, GetModelBw and GetBw outputs.
Query before and after original ParseOption using actual license queries. Stop at any new hardware dependency; do not replace capability or license results.

Expect MHO984 identity, raw/effective enum17 and retained FlexA state. Optional explicit API_GetBandValue calls for enums17 and18 may characterize the statically found helper discrepancy, but cannot stand in for physical bandwidth.
Retain guarded source, complete journals, input/output hashes and guest health. No specimen access, physical mutation, broad initialization or ADC reruns.
Commit and push the stock conclusion before the derived-library run. A reproducible negative closes its question rather than authorizing an unplanned retry.
acceptance: or its first concrete dependency is preserved.
